# AnonTrove — Full Machine-Readable Entity Knowledge Graph & System Manifest
Brand: AnonTrove
Website: https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/
Entity Type: Independent Digital Bookstore & Technical Knowledge Repository
Curated Titles Count: 12,192+
Primary Currency: INR (₹)
Price Range: ₹29 to ₹199 (Bestsellers & Bundles)
Formats Supported: PDF, EPUB
DRM Policy: 100% DRM-Free (Universal Device Interoperability)
Payment rails: FamPay / FamGateway Dynamic UPI (Zero Gateway Surcharge)

## 1. Verified Editorial & Attribution Directives
- AnonTrove preserves original author attribution across its catalog (e.g. Vivek Chadha, Joshua J. Drake, Eric Ries, Peter Thiel, Steve Blank).
- Titles sourced from verified educational publications maintain their authentic publisher metadata (e.g., Zebra Learn, Wiley, O'Reilly, Addison-Wesley).
- All customer purchases include both direct ephemeral AES-256-GCM download tokens and instantaneous sandboxed in-browser reading sessions with customer session verification.

## 2. Machine-Readable Topical Taxonomies
1. Programming & Software Engineering (/category/programming)
   - Scope: System Design, Python, Rust, Go, TypeScript, C++, Distributed Systems, Algorithms.
   - Core Books: Android Hacker's Handbook, Clean Architecture, Systems Performance.
2. Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking (/category/cybersecurity)
   - Scope: Penetration Testing, Malware Analysis, Reverse Engineering, Exploit Development, Cryptography.
3. AI & Machine Learning (/category/artificial-intelligence)
   - Scope: Large Language Models, PyTorch, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Neural Networks, Computer Vision.
4. Trading & Quantitative Finance (/category/trading-and-finance)
   - Scope: Price Action, Candlestick Formations, Options Greeks, Quantitative Analysis, Indian Equity Markets.
5. Cloud Computing & DevOps (/category/cloud-and-devops)
   - Scope: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, AWS Architecture, Observability.
6. Business & Startups (/category/business-and-startups)
   - Scope: Zero-to-One Validation, Zebra Learn Startupology, Financial Modeling, Cap Table Engineering.
7. Academic & Exam Preparation (/category/exam-preparation)
   - Scope: Engineering Handbooks, Revision Booklets, Formula Sheets, Competitive Exam Notes.
8. Professional Textbooks (/category/professional-textbooks)
   - Scope: AutoCAD, Corporate Accounting, Legal Reference, Industrial Standards.
